# Clipcy

> Clipcy is a free, open-source clipboard manager for Windows. Search clipboard history, pin reusable items, and preview copied text, images, and files before pasting.

Author: Đào Anh Thành, identified in the website footer. Source code and issue tracking are available at https://github.com/daoanhthanh/clipcy.

## What it does

- **Search**: Open with Alt+V and start typing to filter clipboard history
- **Pin**: Keep frequently used items at the top
- **Preview**: See content before pasting
- **Keyboard-first**: Alt+V to open, arrow keys to navigate, Enter to paste

## Platform support

- Windows (implemented)
- macOS and Linux (planned)

## Storage

All clipboard history stored locally at `%LOCALAPPDATA%\clipcy\clipcy.db`. No cloud sync, no analytics, no remote storage.
The local database is not encrypted. Copied files are stored as paths rather than archived copies; moving or deleting the original file breaks its preview.

## Build from source

Repository: https://github.com/daoanhthanh/clipcy

Requirements:
- Rust (latest stable)
- .NET 10 SDK
- Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools
- UniFFI bindgen for C#

Build steps:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/daoanhthanh/clipcy.git
cd clipcy
cargo build --release -p clipcy-bridge
uniffi-bindgen-cs --library target/release/clipcy_core.dll --out-dir apps/clipcy-windows/Bindings
.\scripts\build-windows-ui.ps1 -Release
```

## Languages

User interface available in: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Korean, Vietnamese.
